blind.description: A stylized fantasy/medieval shop sign meant for wall mounting. It consists of a horizontal wooden beam with a metal wall mounting bracket on one end and a metal cap on the other, suspended from which by two metal bands is a double-sided shield-shaped sign board. The board features a reddish-brown wooden frame and an off-white face displaying sculpted 3D depictions of a tied grain/money sack and a lantern on both sides. Surfaces are smooth, solid, and cleanly textured in a stylized hand-painted art style.
blind.from_above: A horizontal wooden beam with dark metal bands and a wall-mounting flange on the right end, with the relief shapes of a sack and lantern protruding slightly from the front and back faces below.
blind.height_vs_figure: About 2 to 2.5 feet tall (reaching roughly knee height of the 5 ft 9 in figure) and about 2.5 to 3 feet wide.
